Goodbye Belly Full Body Dumbbell Home Workout

A beginner-friendly full body dumbbell routine designed to tone your legs, shoulders, back, arms, and core. This targeted circuit helps increase caloric burn and build functional strength right from home.

15–20 min
Duration
5
Exercises
1 Circuit

Exercise Flow

Check off each exercise as you complete sets. Rest timer at the bottom.
01

Squat with Dumbbell Front Raise

3 × 15–20 reps
QuadricepsGlutesAnterior DeltoidsCore
  • Keep your chest upright and core engaged as you lower into a squat.
  • Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height in a controlled motion.

Why: Engages large muscle groups in the lower and upper body simultaneously to maximize burn and tone thighs.

02

Standing Alternating Dumbbell Toe Touch

3 × 12–15 reps per side
HamstringsLower BackObliquesGlutes
  • Hinge at the hips with a flat back as you reach the dumbbell across to the opposite foot.
  • Squeeze your glutes and core to drive back up to standing position.

Why: Strengthens the posterior chain and tone your lower back and legs through dynamic rotation.

03

Kneeling Dumbbell Overhead Shoulder Press

3 × 12–15 reps
DeltoidsTricepsUpper ChestCore
  • Maintain a tall kneeling position with glutes squeezed to eliminate lower back arching.
  • Press the dumbbells directly overhead, locking out smoothly at the top.

Why: Builds shoulder strength and stability while challenging core posture from a kneeling base.

04

Kneeling Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension

3 × 12–15 reps
TricepsCore
  • Keep elbows pointing forward and close to your head throughout the lift.
  • Lower the weight behind your head with control and press back up to full extension.

Why: Isolates and tightens the triceps to eliminate arm flab and sculpt arms.

05

Lying Single-Arm Dumbbell Opposite Toe Touch

3 × 12–15 reps per side
Rectus AbdominisObliquesHip Flexors
  • Press your lower back firmly into the mat as you raise your opposite leg and reach the dumbbell up.
  • Control the lowering phase to maintain constant core tension.

Why: Targets the entire abdominal wall to trim the waistline and tighten the midsection.

Trainer Tips

  • Focus on slow and controlled movements rather than rushing reps.
  • Choose a dumbbell weight that allows you to maintain clean form throughout every set.
